source: 563 Another Attempt
target: 563 Alterus Conatus

source: 563 Another Attempt
target: 563 Alterus Conatus

source: Upon learning the intricacies of Louis Berry’s collaboration and his unwavering commitment, Juan Oro found himself questioning the reliability of his own ears once again.
target: Notis intricatis consortionis Ludovici Berry et eius indefessae dedicationis adeptus, Iuanus Oro iterum se ipsos interrogavit de fidelitate aurium suarum.

source: It wasn’t that the other party’s demands were outrageous or absurd, making it sound like some kind of jest.
target: Non enim postulata alterius partis erant indecentes nec absurda, ita ut quasi iocus videbantur.

source: On the contrary, the Fisheries Guild could fulfill his desires with minimal effort, without requiring a substantial payment.
target: Contra vero, Corporatio Piscatoria desideria eius minimo opere exsequi poterat, sine magno pretio postulato.

source: This went beyond Juan Oro’s initial expectations.
target: Hoc transgressit initiales exspectationes Iuani Oro.

source: Prior to meeting Louis Berry, he had mentally prepared himself for potential ruthless “extortion.”
target: Ante Ludovicum Berry convenire, se mente praeparaverat ad extortionem inhumanam.

source: After all, considering the ease with which the other party subdued Lato Guiaro and displayed strength against the Fisheries Guild, Oro had anticipated a tougher negotiation.
target: Postremo, cum consideraret quomodo altera pars Lato Guiaro subiecit et contra Corporatum Piscatorium vim ostendit, Oro duriorem tractationem praevidit.

source: Surprisingly, Louis Berry proved to be more amenable to discussion than Oro had envisioned.
target: Admirabiliter, Ludovicus Berry ad colloquium magis paratus esse apparuit quam Oro praevidisset.

source: This led Juan Oro to contemplate whether there might be some deception at play.
target: Hoc adduxit Iuanum Oro ad considerandum utrum aliqua deceptio in ludo esset.

source: He wondered if, in the future, Berry would abruptly turn against him during their collaboration, breaking the promises made.
target: Mirabatur num in futurum Berry, dum collaborabant, repente adversus eum verteret, promissa fregens.

source: Lumian observed the wrinkled old man silently, refraining from clarifying his intentions.
target: Lumian senem rugosum silentio observavit, a propositis suis explanandis abstinens.

source: Explaining might expose his true motives, and the timing wasn’t right yet.
target: Explicare eius veros intentos detegere posset, et tempus nondum idoneum erat.

source: After careful consideration, Juan Oro let out a sigh of age.
target: Post diligentem considerationem, Iuanus Oro suspirium senectutis edidit.

source: “We can accede to your request.”
target: «Ad petitionem tuam consentire possumus.»

source: “However, throughout our collaboration, we will remain vigilant and formulate contingency plans.”
target: «Attamen, per nostra collaborationem, vigiles manebimus et consilia subsidia pariemus.»

source: Lumian smiled, rising from the suspended armchair in the void.
target: Lumian subridens ex sellā suspendita in vacuo surrexit.

source: He extended his right hand to Juan Oro.
target: Manum dexteram ad Iuanum Oro extendit.

source: “Pleasure working with you.”
target: «Mihi placet tecum operari.»

source: Juan Oro shook his hand and remarked, “You’re not as crazy as you seem…”
target: Iuanus Oro manum eius concussit et inquit, «Non es tam insanus quam videaris…»

source: Lumian pondered for a moment and smirked.
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et subridens.

source: “Of course, I’ve always been a clever, rational, and polite adventurer.”
target: «Certe, semper fui callidus, rationabilis, et urbanus viator.»

source: Juan Oro wasn’t in the mood for idle chatter.
target: Iuanus Oro ad inanem sermonicam non se paratus habebat.

source: He nodded at Louis Berry and stated, “Given your preference for discretion in our collaboration, I should depart now.
target: Iuanus Oro ad Ludovicum Berry annuens dixit, «Quoniam ex tua discretione in nostra cooperatione, nunc discedere mihi oportet.»

source: Otherwise, my visit might become known to others.”
target: Alioquin, adventus meus aliis patebit.

source: Lumian took a moment to contemplate before responding, “I’ll dispatch my concealed companion to Milo Village tomorrow night.
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est, deinde respondit: «Socium meum occultum cras vespere ad Vicum Milo mittam.»

source: Ensure the surviving sailors from last year’s ritual are brought to your main building in advance and kept under control.”
target: Fac ut nautae supersistentes ex ritu anni praeteriti ad aedificium principale tuum praevideantur et sub moderamine retineantur.

source: “Agreed.” Juan Oro didn’t object; this was one of the terms they had agreed upon.
target: «Consentio.» Iuanus Oro non objicit; hoc una ex conditionibus concordatis erat.

source: As the cane-wielding old man prepared to leave, Lumian called out thoughtfully,
target: Dum senex baculo utens discedere parabat, Lumian meditabundus exclamavit:

source: “I’m a man of my word. I promised Giorgia I wouldn’t disclose the details of the commission to anyone.
target: «Vir sum verbi mei. Promisi Giorgiae me commissionis singularia neminimo aliqui revelaturum esse.»

source: “But I have a question for you. Have any Children of the Sea from the Paco family gone missing recently or not been seen for an extended period?”
target: «Sed habeo tibi quaestionem. Num aliqui Filii Maris ex familia Paco nuper evanuerunt vel diu non visi sunt?»

source: He hinted that his inquiry was linked to the Paco family’s commission.
target: Indicavit quaestionem suam cum commissione familiae Paco conexam esse.

source: Juan Oro’s expression darkened as he contemplated for more than ten seconds.
target: Vultus Iuani Oro obscuratus est, dum per plus quam decem secunda meditabat.

source: “The Paco family’s Children of the Sea have made appearances recently.
target: «Filii Maris familiae Paco nuper apparuerunt.

source: “At first, I thought something had happened to Rubió’s mother, Martha, that we shouldn’t know about.
target: «Initio putavi aliquid evenisse matri Rubió, Martha, quod nescire debuimus.

source: Yet, it turns out she’s still fine, just severely injured.”
target: At, apparuit eam adhuc esse incolumem, sed graviter laesa est.

source: No missing Children of the Sea from the Paco family?
target: Nonne nulli Filii Maris ex familia Paco absentes sunt?

source: Where did the humanoid lizard come from?
target: Unde orta est lacerta, quae humano similis est?

source: Lumian was alarmed.
target: Lumian consternatus est.

source: His initial thought was that the Paco family might be involved with other Children of the Sea.
target: Prima eius cogitatio fuit quod familia Paco fortasse cum aliis Filiis Maris implicaretur.

source: His second thought was that one of the Paco family’s Children of the Sea might have been replaced.
target: Secunda eius cogitatio fuit quod unus ex Filiis Maris familiae Paco substitutus esset.

source: Is the impostor parading around with the original’s face, while the real individual had transformed into a humanoid lizard, meeting their demise at the hands of the great adventurer?
target: Num impostor, vultum originalis ferens, vagatur, dum verus homo in lacertam, similem homini, conversus est atque a magno viatore interfectus est?

source: Lumian couldn’t help but associate the substitute and the frequent appearances of the person in question with a Sequence name: Faceless!
target: Lumian non potuit quin substitutum et frequentes manifestationes personae in quaestione ad nomen Sequenciae: Faceless coniungeret!

source: It aligned with the Lie earring’s Sequence—the previous Sequence of Marionettist Loki!
target: Consonabat cum Sequencia "Lie Earring"—praevia Sequencia Marionettistae Loki!

source: Could it be that after Loki’s resurrection, he infiltrated Port Santa and clandestinely replaced a key member of the Paco family?
target: Num fieri potuit ut post resurrectionem Loki, Portum Santae infiltratus, et clandestine membrum praecipuum familiae Paco substituisset?

source: Was his goal to set a trap for me and execute something during the sea prayer ritual, continuing what he had left incomplete the previous year?
target: Num finis eius esset mihi laqueum parare et aliquid exsequi in ritu orationis maris, continuans id quod anno praeterito relictum erat?

source: With these thoughts swirling, Lumian couldn’t help but experience a blend of excitement and fear.
target: His cogitationibus circumvolantibus, Lumian excitatio et timor miscendi affectus sensit.

source: However, upon further consideration, he dismissed the notion.
target: Attamen, post ulteriora consideratione, notionem illa destitit.

source: If Loki had genuinely substituted an essential member of the Paco family, there wouldn’t be any humanoid lizard sightings.
target: Si Loki vere membrum essentiale familiae Paco substituisset, appariciones lacertae hominiformis nullae fuisset.

source: He could have discreetly resolved the issue and erased all traces, avoiding such an obvious loophole!
target: Potuisset rem caute solvere et vestigia omnia delere, ita ut talem evidens hiatus vitaret!

source: Moreover, Rubió Paco wasn’t the sole Child of the Sea in the Paco family.
target: Praeterea, Rubió Paco non erat solus Filius Maris in familia Paco.

source: Martha, as a Maiden of the Sea, also wielded the residual power of the sea.
target: Martha, ut Puella Maris, etiam potentiam residuam maris gerebat.

source: How could they struggle against a humanoid lizard whose strength hadn’t reached the Mid-Sequence?
target: Quomodo poterant pugnare contra lacertam hominiformem, cuius vis ad "Mid-Sequence" nondum pervenisset?

source: Why would they take the risk of exposing the secret and hiring an external adventurer, Louis Berry, to handle the situation?
target: Cur periculum suscipere velint ut secretum patefacerent et adventorem externum, Ludovicum Berry, ad rem administrandam conducerent?

source: With Lumian’s comprehension of the sea prayer ritual and sea spawn deepening, it left him even more bewildered about the Paco family’s previous decisions.
target: Cum cognitione Lumiani de ritu orationis maris et maris progenie augebat, eum adhuc magis de decisionibus praeteritis familiae Paco perplectum reliquit.

source: He believed that crucial information was concealed within.
target: Credidit informationes maximi momenti intus absconditas esse.

source: He turned to Juan Oro, organizing his thoughts.
target: Ad Iuanum Oro se vertit, suas cogitationes ordinans.

source: “Are descendants of the same Maidens of the Sea prohibited from attacking each other?”
target: «Num descendentibus eademum Puellarum Maris inter se pugnare vetitum sit?»

source: “There’s no such restriction.” Juan Oro dismissed Lumian’s speculation.
target: «Talis restrictio non est.» Iuanus Oro speculatio Lumiani reiecit.

source: Lumian deliberately mused aloud, “Then why did the Paco family intentionally hire an outsider like me for the commission instead of utilizing their own Beyonders?”
target: Lumian deliberanter voce edixit, «Cur ergo familia Paco expresse extraneum, ut me conduceret pro commissione, potius quam proprios Beyonders adhiberet?»

source: Juan Oro maintained his serious expression.
target: Iuanus Oro vultum gravem retinuit.

source: “It’s for the same reason I hired someone to monitor Paco’s house.
target: «Idem est, quod aliquem conducui ut domum Paconis custodiret.»

source: That’s why I sent the Little Devil to interrogate you.
target: Quare Parvum Diabolum ad te interrogandum misi.

source: That’s why I needed to meet Martha.”
target: Quare mihi necessarium fuit Martha convenire.

source: You call that wrinkled, old man-like monster “Little Devil”?
target: Num illud rugosum, senile monstrum, "Parvus Diabolum" vocas?

source: Lumian nodded gently and asked, “The Paco family must be harboring a significant secret.”
target: Lumian leniter annuit et quaesivit, «Familia Paco certe magnum secretum celat.»

source: He refrained from delving deeper and watched as Juan Oro turned away, walking off with his cane.
target: Non ulterius indagare voluit et spectabat, dum Iuanus Oro se avertit, baculo suo ambulans.

source: Soon, the Cosmic Void around him dissipated, and he “returned” to the draped master bedroom of the suite, seated in the armchair before the desk.
target: Mox, Vacuitas Cosmica circa eum evanuit, et ille "rediit" ad cubiculum magnum ornatum suite, sedens in sellā ante mensam.

source: Lumian smiled, pivoted, grasped the curtain, and drew it open.
target: Lumian subridens se vertit, cortinam arripuit et aperuit.

source: The morning sun flooded in, casting a radiant glow.
target: Sol matutinus irrumpit, splendore radiante effusus.

source: The next night, within the ancestral house of the Oro family in Milo Village, a structure only one floor shorter than the residence of the Governor of the Sea.
target: Nocte secunda, intra domum maiorum familiae Oro in Vicus Milo, structura tantum uno tabulato breviore quam residentia Gubernatoris Maris.

source: The building had undergone numerous renovations, showcasing a fusion of antiquated and modern architecture.
target: Aedificium plurimas renovationes habuerat, ostendens mixturam architecturae antiquae et modernae.

source: Blackened gray stone walls stood alongside concrete pillars, and beneath the seaweed-covered roof lay red‐ringed tiles.
target: Muri lapidei grisei nigriti iuxta columnas concreti stabant, et sub tecto operto algis marinis tegulae rubro‐annulatae iacebant.

source: The door to the first-floor lounge had been shut, leaving only an elderly man with a black cane—Juan Oro—and his cherished grandson—Fernandez Oro—
target: Porta ad primum tabulatum conclave clausa erat, relinquens solum senem cum baculo nigro—Iuanus Oro—et nepotem carum—Fernandez Oro—

source: alongside eight unconscious villagers of Milo Village sprawled on the ground.
target: una cum octo incolis vicanis inconscientes in terra iacentes.

source: Suddenly, a shadow flickered in a corner of the room, and a figure materialized.
target: Subito, umbra in angulo conclavis micavit, et figura materialiter apparuit.

source: Standing just over 1.7 meters tall, the figure possessed an ordinary face and sported a brownish-green short-sleeved shirt, loose brownish-yellow pants, strapless leather shoes with vents, and a short circular felt hat.
target: Stans paulo plus quam 1.7 metra altus, figura faciem ordinarum habebat atque indutus erat tunica brevis manica fusco-viride, bracas laxas fusco-flavas, calceos ex coriaceo sine cingulis cum foramina, et petasum feltrinum breve rotundum.

source: “Who are you?” Juan Oro inquired in Intisian.
target: «Quis es tu?» Iuanus Oro in Intisiana quaesivit.

source: As one of Port Santa’s strongest sea merchants, he had sailed numerous times between the ages of 30 and 50.
target: Ut unus ex fortissimis negotiatoribus maritimis Portus Santae, multoties navigaverat inter annos 30 et 50.

source: It was only natural for him to comprehend Intisian.
target: Naturale erat ei Intisianam linguam intellegere.

source: The man responded fluently in Highlander, “I’m Louis Berry’s companion. You can call me Charname.”
target: Vir in lingua Highlander fluenter respondit, «Socius sum Ludovici Berry. Me Charname vocare potes.»

source: It doesn’t seem like the spirit-type Beyonder Lato encountered…
target: Non videtur esse ut spiritus generis Beyonder quem Lato occurrit…

source: Louis Berry has more than one companion lurking in the shadows…
target: Ludovicus Berry plus quam unum socium in tenebris latitantem habet…

source: Juan Oro rejoiced that he had chosen negotiation first.
target: Iuanus Oro exsultavit quod primum negotiationem elegisset.

source: With these thoughts racing through his mind, he glanced at Fernandez, whose face remained pale, and understood that he wasn’t entirely pleased.
target: His cogitationibus per mentem currantibus, ad Fernandez intuens, cuius facies pallida manebat, intellexit eum non omnino laetum esse.

source: It was common for young lads to be calculating about who suffered and who benefited, often forgetting their most essential motives.
target: Communiter iuvenes computabant, quis pati et quis lucrari, saepe obliti suarum principalium volitionum.

source: “You can start questioning them,” Juan Oro instructed the man known as Charname.
target: «Potes incipere eos interrogare,» Iuanus Oro viro Charname noto imperavit.

source: “Over the past year, we’ve employed various methods to determine if they’re lying or not.
target: «Per annum praeteritum, variis modis investigavimus utrum mendacium dicerent aut non.

source: We’ve even exploited the uniqueness of other sea spawn.
target: Etiam singularitatem aliorum progenie maris adhibuimus.

source: All the results indicate that they’ve told the complete truth and concealed nothing.
target: Omnia indicia ostendunt eos plenam veritatem dixerint neque quidquam celaverint.

source: The failure of the sea prayer ritual has nothing to do with them.
target: Defectus ritu orationis maris nihil ad eos pertinet.

source: Charname’s lips curved into a smile as he replied, “How would I know if I don’t give it a shot myself?”
target: Labia Charname in risum conversae sunt, et respondit: «Quomodo id scirem, nisi ipse conarer?»

source: Approaching the unconscious sailors, he retrieved a dagger and stabbed their fingertips one by one, smearing the corresponding blood on various spots on the back of his hand.
target: Accedens nautas inconscientes, hasta tulit et singulos digitos percussit, sanguinem in diversis partibus dorsum manus suae imprimitens.

source: Amidst the pain, the sailors began to awaken one after another.
target: Inter dolorem, nautae uno post alium evigere coeperunt.

source: In front of them, Charname produced a mirror and smiled.
target: Coram illis, Charname speculum produxit et subridens.

source: “Your blood will reveal if you’re lying and if you’re the genuine person.
target: «Sanguis vester ostendet num mentimini et num persona vera sitis.

source: If anyone deceives me, their blood will burn on the mirror, and they’ll face the same fate.
target: Si quis me decipiat, sanguis eius in speculo ardebit, et eandem sortem patiendum habebit.

source: “Alright, answer them one by one.”
target: «Ita, responde uno post alium.»

source: As Charname spoke, he calmly transferred the blood from the back of his hand to the mirror, a strange sight as it seemed to seep into the glass.
target: Dum Charname loquebatur, sanguinem ex dorso manus suae ad speculum tranquilliter transtulit, spectaculum mirum, quod quasi in vitrum se infunderet.

source: The sailors glanced at Juan Oro, realizing this was another investigation into the cause of the sea prayer ritual’s failure last year.
target: Nautae Iuanum Oro intuentes animadvertierunt hoc aliam inquisitionem de causa defectus ritu orationis maris anni praeteriti esse.

source: Skilfully, they recounted their experiences, leaving no details omitted.
target: Arte, suas experientias enarraverunt, nullum singulum omittentes.

source: After hearing their accounts, Charname asked thoughtfully, “Were Iru and Salah responsible for transporting the lamb sacrifices?”
target: Postquam narrationes audivit, Charname cogitabundus rogavit: «Eramne Iru et Salah responsables ad transportanda agnorum sacrificia?»

source: “Yes,” all the sailors replied in unison.
target: «Ita,» omnes nautae simul responderunt.

source: Charname pressed on, “Did they both perish during the sea prayer ritual?”
target: Charname continuavit: «Num uterque in ritu orationis maris perierit?»

source: The surviving sailors nodded, confirming that their two companions had been thrown overboard in the tidal wave of the failed ritual, never to surface again.
target: Nautae supersistentes annuerunt, confirmantes duos socios suis in fluctibus ritu orationis maris defuncti proieci esse, nec umquam iterum apparuerint.

source: Turning to Juan Oro, Charname inquired, “Do you have any belongings from Iru and Salah? Clothes they’ve worn many times, toothbrushes not discarded, and the like.
target: Conversus ad Iuanum Oro, Charname rogavit, «Habesne aliqua supellex de Iru et Salah? Vestimenta quoties gestaverunt, dentifricia nondum abiecta, et similia?»

source: “I want to try summoning their spirits.
target: «Volo spiritus eorum evocare.

source: Although most of their spirits would have dissipated over the past year and can’t remember effective information, the state of their spirits can reveal certain things, such as deep resentment and hatred.”
target: Quamquam pleraque eorum spiritus per annum praeteritum evanuerunt et informationem efficacem meminisse non possint, status eorum spirituum quaedam revelare potest, ut profunda invidia et odium.

source: Juan Oro shook his head.
target: Iuanus Oro caput gyravit, negans.

source: “We attempted it after the sea prayer ritual.
target: «Post ritum orationis maris id conati sumus.

source: We couldn’t summon their spirits.
target: Non potuimus spiritus eorum evocare.

source: Those consumed by the raging sea would have their spirits devoured as well.”
target: Illi, a mari furioso devorati, spiritus eorum quoque vellentur.

source: Charname chuckled and suggested, “Let’s give it another shot. There’s nothing to lose by trying.”
target: Charname subridens risit et suadit: «Iterum conemur. Nihil amittendum est per conatum.»

source: Juan Oro pondered for a moment and agreed.
target: Iuanus Oro paulisper meditatus et consentivit.

source: He immediately instructed Fernandez to retrieve Iru’s extracted tooth and Salah’s clothes, previously used for spirit channeling.
target: Statim Iuanus Oro Fernandez imperavit ut dentem Iru extractum et vestimenta Salah, quae antea ad spiritus evocandos adhibita erant, adduceret.

source: Then, they observed as Charname set up the altar and initiated a summoning ritual.
target: Deinde, observaverunt dum Charname aram instituit et ritum evocationis initium fecerit.
«Ego!

source: “I summon in my name:
target: «Ego in nomine meo evoco:

source: “The sailor of Port Santa’s Milo Village, a man named Iru Adela, the owner of this tooth…”
target: «Nauta Vicus Milo Portus Santae, vir nomine Iru Adela, huius dentis possessor…

source: A gust of wind blew, and the altar’s candle flame took on a dark-green hue.
target: Inflavit ventus, et flamma candelæ aræ viridi obscuro colore induta est.

source: A blurry figure quickly materialized.
target: Figura obscura celeriter apparuit.

source: Success? He actually succeeded?
target: Successus? Vere successit?

source: Fernandez’s pupils dilated as he gazed above the candle flame.
target: Pupillae Fernandez dilatatae sunt, dum super flammam candelæ spectabat.

source: The figure vaguely resembled Iru, but it showed no signs of drowning; its skin was pale-white and swollen.
target: Figura vix Iru similis erat, sed nullas signa submersionis ostendebat; cutis eius pallide alba et tumida erat.

source: Instead, its face was covered in blood, and there was an evident wound on its forehead.
target: Proinde, facies eius sanguine operta erat, et vulneratio manifesta in fronte eius videbatur.

source: The specter’s eyes brimmed with pain and hatred.
target: Oculi phantasmatis dolore atque odio repleti erant.
